body.purpose: Chat readout, controls, statuses, and candidate replies.

label-mono.purpose: Keyboard shortcut and key-entry metadata only.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single action that advances from chat context to a fresh suggestion.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2ba994; color: #0d1216; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 18px; font: 700 11px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #45d7c1; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #45d7c1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { color: #5a736f; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A calibration or cancellation control that supports but does not lead the workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #202a30; color: #eef7f5; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 18px; font: 400 10px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #2a373d; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #45d7c1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Relationship Segment
components.description: Equal-width tone selectors; selection invalidates old candidate content.
components.css: .ds-segment { background: #202a30; color: #a6b8b5; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 6px 11px; font: 400 10px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; } .ds-segment-active { background: #2ba994; color: #0d1216; } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #45d7c1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Reply Choice
components.description: A current-generation candidate that copies its own text only after the user chooses it.
components.css: .ds-reply { width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #151d22; color: #eef7f5; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 14px; font: 400 10px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif; } .ds-reply:hover { background: #2a373d; } .ds-reply:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #45d7c1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-reply:disabled { color: #76908c; }

components.name: Masked Key Field
components.description: An in-memory API key field with masked characters and a clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-key { background: #0f1418; color: #eef7f5; border: 1px solid #37514f; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 10px; font: 400 10px 'Cascadia Mono', monospace; } .ds-key:focus { outline: 0; border-color: #45d7c1; }

narrative.overview: This is a compact, no-terminal operating surface for a private desktop workflow. Graphite layers hold the work in a low-light chat setting while sea-glass actions distinguish the few moments that need a decision: select a tone, generate, then copy a reply.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained dark tonal layering rather than floating-card depth.
One sea-glass action color, with warm warning and error exceptions.
Dense, desktop-native controls with explicit enabled, disabled, and selected states.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Sea-glass is for a selected state or an action that advances the workflow, never for decorative emphasis.

rules.name: The Read-Then-Act Rule
rules.body: The incoming message remains the first large body region; controls follow it in task order.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Use a surface change to communicate hierarchy or interaction state. Do not add decorative glow, gradients, or floating shadows.

dos: Do use the primary action color only for the selected relationship and the next task action.
Do reset reply choices whenever their relationship or generation context is no longer current.
Do keep chat text and candidate actions visually distinct through hierarchy and labeling.
Do keep manual copy and manual message sending as separate user-controlled steps.
donts: Don't turn the panel into a terminal transcript or a dashboard.
Don't add gradients, glass effects, decorative shadows, or extra color accents.
Don't leave stale candidates enabled while a new generation is pending.
Don't make screenshots or API keys persistent by default.
